highlights.title: Middle East Live: US strikes Iran for first time in a month
highlights.summary: The United States said Sunday it had carried out air strikes on Iranian rocket launchers on a small island in the Strait of Hormuz, its first attacks on Iran since late July. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

highlights.title: US Treasury bars certain journalists from G20 meeting in North Carolina
highlights.summary: The US Treasury Department denied credentials to reporters from The New York Times, Wall Street Journal and Bloomberg for a Group of 20 finance meeting in North Carolina, the latest restriction on media access under President Donald Trump.
